# 99rebels

> 99rebels rebuilds law firm websites for legal professionals worldwide. We specialise in modern, compliant websites for legal practices — from design and development to ongoing maintenance and SEO.

## About

99rebels is a web design and development studio that works exclusively with law firms. We rebuild outdated legal websites into modern, high-performing sites that build client trust and drive enquiries.

## Services

- **Website Rebuilds** — Complete redesign and development of law firm websites
- **Ongoing Maintenance** — Hosting, updates, security, and performance monitoring
- **SEO** — Search engine optimisation tailored for legal services and practice areas

## Target Audience

Law firms, solicitors, barristers, and legal professionals seeking a modern online presence.
